::: {#cor-logistic-odds-ratio}
#### The odds ratio between two predictor vectors

Let $\vpredvar$ and $\vpredvar'$ be [predictor](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-input) vectors in the [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) of @eq-logistic-model.
The [odds ratio](categorical-tests.qmd#def-odds-ratio) of $\vpredvar'$ compared with $\vpredvar$ is the [odds multiplier](#def-odds-multiplier) of their difference:

$$
\orf{\vpredvar', \vpredvar} = \oddsfactorf{\vpredvar' - \vpredvar}.
$$

:::

::: proof

Let $\diffvpredvar \eqdef \vpredvar' - \vpredvar$, so that $\vpredvar' = \vpredvar + \diffvpredvar$, and the first entry of $\diffvpredvar$ is $1 - 1 = 0$.

$$
\ba
\orf{\vpredvar', \vpredvar}
&= \frac{\oddsf{\vpredvar'}}{\oddsf{\vpredvar}}
&& \text{(definition of the odds ratio)}
\\
&= \frac{\oddsf{\vpredvar} \, \oddsfactorf{\diffvpredvar}}{\oddsf{\vpredvar}}
&& \text{(odds multiplier theorem)}
\\
&= \oddsfactorf{\diffvpredvar}.
&& \text{(divide numerator and denominator by } \oddsf{\vpredvar} > 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

The first step is the definition of the [odds ratio](categorical-tests.qmd#def-odds-ratio), and the second is @thm-odds-multiplier.

:::
